info.title: RedFlag_Trail
info.description: Payer-attributed x402 spend ledger for AI agent fleets. Spend is attributed to the payer decoded from the EIP-3009 authorization, never to tx.from (which is the facilitator that relayed it). Measured on Base, those differ on 99.6% of payments. Every response cites transaction hashes.

get.summary: Summarise agent x402 spend, attributed to the real payer
get.description: Totals, top vendors and evidence transaction hashes over a time window. Use this to answer 'what did the fleet spend' without misattributing payments to the relaying facilitator.

get.summary: Registry status, activity and exposure for one vendor
get.description: Combines the ERC-8004 / Agent0 registry record with observed payment activity. A vendor with no registry row is UNCHECKED, which is not the same as unregistered.

get.summary: Open risk findings, each carrying the policy rule it proposes
get.description: Each finding includes proposed_rule: the exact JSON that would be POSTed to the wallet provider to block the vendor at signing time.

post.summary: Replay a proposed rule over indexed history before enforcing it
post.description: Returns what the rule WOULD have blocked and what it would block by mistake. A vendor paid by many independent payers is probably legitimate, so blocking it is probably wrong. Run this before proposing enforcement.

total_usd.description: Sum of amount_usd. NULL amounts (non-stablecoins) are excluded, never counted as zero.

payer_ne_txfrom.description: Payments where the real payer differs from tx.from.

registry.description: ERC-8004 record, or {checked:false} when never looked up.

activity.description: Payment counts, totals and sample transaction hashes.

proposed_rule.description: Policy rule JSON, ready to POST. R4 findings are advisory: the facilitator is not part of the signed message, so no signing-time rule can key on it.

reason.description: Why the rule could not be replayed, when supported is false.

false_positives.description: Targeted vendors that look legitimate, judged by independent payers outside the fleet.
